title: Industrial Machinery Mechanics
description: Repair, install, adjust, or maintain industrial production and processing machinery or refinery and pipeline distribution systems. May also install, dismantle, or move machinery and heavy equipment according to plans.

tasks.text: Repair or maintain the operating condition of industrial production or processing machinery or equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of machinery

dwas.name: Maintain work equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Repair or replace broken or malfunctioning components of machinery or equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Clean, lubricate, or adjust parts, equipment, or machinery.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.
Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.

tasks.text: Disassemble machinery or equipment to remove parts and make repairs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disassembly requires hands-on tool use

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.

tasks.text: Reassemble equipment after completion of inspections, testing, or repairs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Reassembly after repair requires hands-on fitting

dwas.name: Reassemble equipment after repair.

tasks.text: Examine parts for defects, such as breakage or excessive wear.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Locating wear and damage requires physical inspection

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical equipment to locate damage, defects, or wear.

tasks.rationale: text generation — Log maintenance and repair records from data

dwas.name: Maintain repair or maintenance records.

tasks.text: Operate newly repaired machinery or equipment to verify the adequacy of repairs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Record parts or materials used and order or requisition new parts or materials, as necessary.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Record parts and repair details from provided data

dwas.name: Record information about parts, materials or repair procedures.
Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Observe and test the operation of machinery or equipment to diagnose malfunctions, using voltmeters or other testing devices.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Detecting subtle equipment problems needs on-site sensory judgment

dwas.name: Observe equipment in operation to detect potential problems.
Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Analyze test results, machine error messages, or information obtained from operators to diagnose equipment problems.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Performance data analysis; equipment context human

dwas.name: Analyze test or performance data to assess equipment operation.

tasks.text: Study blueprints or manufacturers' manuals to determine correct installation or operation of machinery.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Diagram interpretation partial, human confirms installation

dwas.name: Interpret blueprints, specifications, or diagrams to inform installation, development or operation activities.

tasks.text: Cut and weld metal to repair broken metal parts, fabricate new parts, or assemble new equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cutting to specifications

dwas.name: Cut materials according to specifications or needs.
Operate welding equipment.

tasks.text: Enter codes and instructions to program computer-controlled machinery.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Code entry is routine data input

dwas.name: Enter codes or other information into computers.

tasks.text: Demonstrate equipment functions and features to machine operators.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Operational training requires live human delivery

dwas.name: Train others in operational procedures.

tasks.rationale: decision support — Algorithmic scheduling with human handling constraints and exceptions

dwas.name: Plan employee work schedules.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

dwas.name: Assign duties or work schedules to employees.
